sentences.en: The tyre wall is coated with a reflective material to provide extra visibility in the dark.
sentences.zh: 轮胎壁涂有一层反射材料，以便在黑暗中提供额外的可见性。

sentences.en: She likes to take long walks alone, as they are very reflective.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢独自散步，因为这样可以让她好好思考。

sentences.en: The mirror was so reflective that it almost blinded her when she looked into it.
sentences.zh: 这面镜子非常反光，当她照镜子时差点被晃了眼。
